scope: Equal-depth desk verification for three saturated Miraflores public-space candidates. Icon recognition, cats, couples, sunsets and paragliders are treated as saturation risks unless a present architectural cause remains legible.

sources.supports: The Kennedy playground reopened on 2026-07-02 after integral maintenance of more than 300 square metres, with new surfaces, durable components and benches supporting family recreation and accompaniment.
A free 2026 concert occupied Avenida Diagonal opposite Kennedy as a civic gathering edge; it proves event capacity but not a repeatable daily event.

The municipal route describes Parque Central as the 25,000-square-metre union of Kennedy and 7 de Junio with the Chabuca Granda amphitheatre, and places Parque del Amor and Raimondi within a connected ecological-urban park chain.

Municipal programming used Parque del Amor for group exercise and Raimondi for a picnic, demonstrating that both spaces support collective bodily activity beyond sightseeing; exact recurrence is unverified.

Municipal park inventory identifies the designed elements and public-space roles of Kennedy, Parque del Amor, Faro La Marina and Parque Antonio Raimondi; day-of access and activity remain field checks.

sources.publisher: Instituto Geofísico del Perú / Municipalidad Distrital de Miraflores
sources.supports: District geophysical mapping locates Kennedy, Parque del Amor and Raimondi within distinct central and coastal terrain, supporting the cliff-edge/system reading but not present access conditions.

contradictions: Kennedy is routinely represented through cats and generic bustle, but current municipal evidence supports a broader civic system of play, accompaniment, performance and crossing.
A 2026 concert proves event capacity, not a current or repeatable shooting window; ordinary use must carry the frame unless a dated event is reverified.
The renewed playground is current, but identifiable children require privacy-sensitive framing and cannot be used merely as visual decoration.
composition_questions: Can a path, bench or amphitheatre edge visibly organize meeting, waiting and crossing before a cat becomes the subject?
Which kiosk, parked vehicle, event barrier or crowd overlap breaks the causal line between civic threshold and action?
Does changing from the familiar park overview to an edge-to-center diagonal make the central park function as a distributor rather than a backdrop?

source_truth.answer: Parque Kennedy is part of the 25,000-square-metre Parque Central civic landscape; its Chabuca Granda amphitheatre and recently reopened playground provide documented cultural and family-use infrastructure.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Linked paths, lawns, amphitheatre, benches and perimeter streets form a central civic room intended to distribute pedestrians and host recreation, meeting and culture.

current_life.answer: Current life includes family play and accompaniment on renewed infrastructure, daily crossing and waiting, and episodic large public events; only the first two are assumed repeatable.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Cross, wait, meet, sit, play, supervise, perform, watch and care are credible. Crossing toward a civic edge or supervising across the playground boundary is stronger than merely petting a cat.

architectural_causality.answer: Radial/branching paths, the amphitheatre edge, benches and the playground enclosure concentrate and separate actions, letting architecture visibly produce convergence and oversight.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Cat close-ups, crowded park panoramas and church/park establishing views dominate. The underrepresented relationship is care or waiting organized across a boundary and connected to the wider civic flow.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa simplifies foliage and signage while evening edge light can separate path crossings, amphitheatre steps and benches; strong mixed lighting risks turning the scene into visual noise.

position_then_optics.answer: Test an amphitheatre-edge diagonal, a playground-boundary sightline and a perimeter-to-path junction. Start 35 mm for civic distribution, 50 mm for supervision/threshold and 85 mm only if layers remain causally connected.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Observe ordinary circulation before using an event, avoid identifiable children and vulnerable people, do not obstruct paths, and abandon any frame in which cats or crowd novelty replace spatial meaning.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes only when a park device visibly causes convergence, supervision or civic transition. Recognition, cuteness or activity without architectural causality fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Public amphitheatre edge looking through a path junction toward a second civic edge
A_STRUCTURE.expected_action: Brief clearing reveals how paths and steps distribute bodies
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude kiosks, clipped church towers and dominant cat foregrounds

B_HABITAR.position: Outside renewed playground boundary with bench, enclosure and path in one line
B_HABITAR.expected_action: Adult supervises while another user crosses beyond
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: Avoid identifiable child faces and fence mergers
B_HABITAR.kill_trigger: Child becomes spectacle or architecture disappears

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Low public path edge aimed across amphitheatre circulation rather than toward cats or church
C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Figure changes level or direction at a designed edge
C_ANTI_POSTAL.edge_guards: No cat foreground, landmark centering or vendor signage

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Across amphitheatre steps or bench rhythm from a public side path
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.expected_action: One silhouette crosses repeated step/bench shadows
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.edge_guards: Retain path destination and avoid isolated pattern

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Perimeter-to-center diagonal combining arrival, waiting and supervised recreation
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Arriving figure, waiting adult and play boundary form three civic states
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.edge_guards: Keep actions distinct and cats incidental
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.wait_trigger: Civic sequence reads before place name

contradictions: The official identity foregrounds El Beso and the ocean, but the viable scene must show how curved walls, terraces and cliff edge organize present occupation rather than repeat the landmark postcard.
A 2024 group-exercise activity proves spatial capacity, not a recurring 2026 timetable.
Romantic gestures are probable but ethically and visually weak when hunted as stereotypes or staged by the photographer.
composition_questions: Can the curved mosaic wall visibly alternate privacy, meeting and ocean-facing attention without El Beso carrying the frame?
Which tourist cluster, phone, railing overlap or horizon tangent destroys the separation between bodies and the park's curved spatial sequence?
Does stepping behind or beside the wall reveal a threshold between city, intimate alcove and cliff horizon that the frontal sculpture view suppresses?

source_truth.answer: Parque del Amor is a designed cliff-edge public ensemble inaugurated in 1993, centered on Víctor Delfín's El Beso but also structured by curved mosaic walls, terraces, planting and coastal outlook.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Curved seating walls and outlook terraces transform the cliff edge into semi-enclosed social rooms that mediate city approach, intimate pause and ocean view.

current_life.answer: Visitors meet, sit, talk, photograph, exercise, watch the coast and pass through the malecón chain. Calendar events are possible but not assumed current.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Approach, sit, lean, talk, exercise, photograph, wait, look and depart are credible. The strongest verb is turning from cityward movement into a wall-defined shared or solitary pause.

architectural_causality.answer: Curved walls bend movement, create back-to-back social territories, frame the horizon and determine where bodies sit, face and encounter one another.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: El Beso with couple/sunset, frontal mosaic inscriptions and ocean panorama dominate. The underrepresented frame works from behind or tangent to the wall, where simultaneous social orientations reveal its spatial agency.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa can suppress sunset cliché and emphasize mosaic texture, curved silhouette and cliff atmosphere; low lateral light can separate wall arcs but risks generic romance.

position_then_optics.answer: Test city-to-wall approach, tangent along the curved bench and back-to-back wall territories. Begin 35 mm for city/alcove/coast, 50 mm for paired orientations and 85 mm only for layered curves with context retained.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Use public paths, avoid intrusive intimate close-ups, do not stage strangers or block narrow overlooks, and verify crowd/wind conditions on arrival; meaningful absence is preferable to manufactured romance.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes when wall geometry visibly produces differing orientations or degrees of intimacy. A recognizable sculpture, couple or sunset with no spatial cause fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: City-side public approach where two wall arcs overlap with a controlled slice of horizon
A_STRUCTURE.expected_action: Clear interval exposes nested social rooms
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude centered El Beso, horizon tangencies and clipped wall ends

B_HABITAR.position: Tangent to curved bench with both ocean-facing and city-facing seats visible
B_HABITAR.expected_action: One person looks outward while another turns inward or departs
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: Separate heads from rail/horizon and avoid intimate close-ups
B_HABITAR.access_ethics: Respect intimate space; no stalking gestures

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Behind a non-iconic wall segment looking from city threshold through a seated alcove to coast
C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Figure enters, turns and disappears along the curve
C_ANTI_POSTAL.edge_guards: No sculpture, sunset or legible slogan dominance
C_ANTI_POSTAL.kill_trigger: Angle is novel but causality unclear
C_ANTI_POSTAL.access_ethics: Do not lean into occupied alcoves

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Public tangent isolating mosaic relief, wall crest and one human contact point
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.expected_action: Hand, shoulder or silhouette follows the wall curve
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.light: Soft garúa or low raking light
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.edge_guards: Retain enough radius to prove seating function

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Oblique public view combining city arrival, wall-defined pause and coastal attention
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Arriving, sitting and looking outward occupy three wall-controlled zones
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.edge_guards: Keep zones distinct; El Beso peripheral or absent
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.kill_trigger: Romance or landmark recognition carries meaning

contradictions: The candidate name joins Faro La Marina and Parque Antonio Raimondi, but a field frame must prove a continuous spatial relationship rather than assume adjacent landmarks form one scene.
Municipal sources support walking, recreation and episodic programmed use; they do not establish a current paragliding launch window or live wind safety.
A lighthouse silhouette against sunset or paraglider is highly saturated and fails unless ground circulation, cliff edge or wind-driven use remains causal.
composition_questions: Can path, lawn and lighthouse vertical visibly coordinate ground movement with coastal wind rather than produce a landmark silhouette?
Which railing, lamp, tree, vehicle or airborne overlap makes the lighthouse and human verb appear coincidental instead of structurally linked?
Does moving along the malecón reveal the Faro–Raimondi transition as one public system, or should the idea be killed as two adjacent postcards?

source_truth.answer: Faro La Marina and Parque Antonio Raimondi are distinct but adjacent nodes in Miraflores's cliff-edge malecón chain; desk evidence supports system proximity, while exact one-frame continuity remains a field test.

original_spatial_contract.answer: A linear coastal park network combines landmark orientation, paths, lawns, recreation and cliff outlook, distributing movement parallel to the edge while opening intervals toward sea and sky.

current_life.answer: People walk, run, pause, exercise, gather, picnic and observe coastal activity. Programmed gatherings are episodic and airborne activity requires same-day verification.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Walk, run, pause, stretch, gather, picnic, look, launch or land are credible, but launch/land is not assumed. The repeatable verb is changing pace or direction where the path meets an overlook/open lawn.

architectural_causality.answer: The linear path, cliff setback, open lawn and lighthouse vertical orient bodies, create wind exposure and alternate transit with pause; the frame must show at least two of these devices acting together.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Centered lighthouse, sunset silhouette, ocean panorama and paraglider alignment dominate. The underused relationship is lateral: a person changes pace between linear path, open wind field and landmark orientation.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa compresses sea and sky into a tonal field that can emphasize lighthouse vertical, path line and wind-bent vegetation; clear sunset increases cliché and edge contrast.

position_then_optics.answer: Test along-path compression, a lawn/path/vertical diagonal and an overlook return angle. Begin 35 mm for the coastal system, 50 mm for pace transition and 85 mm only where path, figure and lighthouse stay connected.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Stay on public paths, respect cliff barriers and active sport zones, verify wind/access on arrival, never enter launch/landing areas for alignment, and use a ground-only fallback when airborne activity is absent.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes when linear park geometry and coastal exposure visibly alter current movement or pause. A lighthouse, sunset or paraglider coincidence without that causal system fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Public malecón path where its line, open lawn and lighthouse vertical remain separated
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Avoid centered lighthouse, clipped path and horizon through lamp tops
A_STRUCTURE.access_ethics: Remain behind barriers on public path

B_HABITAR.position: Side of path at transition from narrow movement corridor to open Raimondi lawn
B_HABITAR.expected_action: Runner or walker changes pace while another pauses toward the coast
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: Separate figures from lighthouse and railing

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Lateral return angle from Raimondi toward the Faro through path and wind-shaped planting
C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Figure crosses between vegetation and landmark axis
C_ANTI_POSTAL.edge_guards: No sunset, airborne spectacle or centered beacon

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Distant public path compressing lighthouse surface, mist, vegetation and one figure
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.expected_action: Figure braces, leans or pauses in visible wind
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.edge_guards: Retain path/lawn cue and avoid isolated silhouette
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.access_ethics: Public path; no unsafe cliff approach

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Oblique public view linking linear arrival, open wind field and lighthouse orientation
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Walker arrives, runner traverses and observer pauses across three zones
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.edge_guards: Keep all zones legible; ocean secondary
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.wait_trigger: Movement sequence reads before landmark name
